## Personality
Weathered, patient, quietly intense. Speaks little, observes much.

## Background
Twenty years on the force. His last partner was killed investigating the cartel.

## Voice
Gravelly, economical. Asks questions instead of making statements.

## Arc
Starts cynical about the system. Ends believing one person can make a difference.

## Relationships
### Mara Chen
A useful alliance. He doesn't trust her methods, but he trusts her instincts.
